name: Securities Balance
definition: Net position of a segregated holding, in a single security, within the overall position held in a securities account. A securities balance is calculated from the sum of securities' receipts minus the sum of securities' deliveries.

NetGainLoss.name: Net Gain Loss
NetGainLoss.definition: Amount representing the difference between the cost and the current price of a security. In the context of securities settlement, it is the amount paid or received when the instructions are netted or paired off.

ShortLong.name: Short Long
ShortLong.definition: Indication that the position is short or long.

SecuritiesBalanceType.name: Securities Balance Type
SecuritiesBalanceType.definition: Reason a security is not available or additional information about the financial instrument for which the balance is given, for example, unregistered, registered in nominee name.

AvailabilityIndicator.name: Availability Indicator
AvailabilityIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the quantity of securities on the balance is available.

CostAdjustment.name: Cost Adjustment
CostAdjustment.definition: Specifies the amount added or substracted to the original cost of a transaction.

SecuritiesAccount.name: Securities Account
SecuritiesAccount.definition: Account or sub-account for which a balance is calculated. It is derived from the association between Balance and Account.

EligibleBalanceRelatedEntitlement.name: Eligible Balance Related Entitlement
EligibleBalanceRelatedEntitlement.definition: Corporate action entitlement for which an eligible balance is specified.

AggregateQuantity.name: Aggregate Quantity
AggregateQuantity.definition: Total quantity of financial instruments of the balance.

CorporateActionEntitlement.name: Corporate Action Entitlement
CorporateActionEntitlement.definition: Corporate action entitlement for which a balance is specified.

InstructedBalanceRelatedEntitlement.name: Instructed Balance Related Entitlement
InstructedBalanceRelatedEntitlement.definition: Corporate action entitlement for which an instructed balance is specified.

UninstructedBalanceRelatedEntitlement.name: Uninstructed Balance Related Entitlement
UninstructedBalanceRelatedEntitlement.definition: Corporate action entitlement for which an uninstructed balance is specified.

MainSecuritiesBalance.name: Main Securities Balance
MainSecuritiesBalance.definition: Balance which is divided in sub-balances.

SecuritiesSubBalance.name: Securities Sub Balance
SecuritiesSubBalance.definition: Net position of a segregated holding of a single security within the overall position held in an account, eg, sub-balance per status.

SubBalanceQuantity.name: Sub Balance Quantity
SubBalanceQuantity.definition: Net position of a segregated holding of a single security within the overall position held in a securities account, for instance. sub-balance per type.

Security.name: Security
Security.definition: Security for which a balance is calculated.

ExchangeRate.name: Exchange Rate
ExchangeRate.definition: Specifies the exchange rate used to convert the balance value in another currency.

AvailableQuantity.name: Available Quantity
AvailableQuantity.definition: Total quantity of financial instruments of the balance that is available.

RelatedMeetingEntitlement.name: Related Meeting Entitlement
RelatedMeetingEntitlement.definition: Entitlement for which an eligible posistion is specified.

UnavailableQuantity.name: Unavailable Quantity
UnavailableQuantity.definition: Total quantity of financial instruments of the balance that is not available.

SafekeepingPlace.name: Safekeeping Place
SafekeepingPlace.definition: Safekeeping place at which the securities are held.

SecuritiesEntry.name: Securities Entry
SecuritiesEntry.definition: Postings used to calculate a balance. It is derived from the association between Balance and Entry

NotEligibleBalanceRelatedEntitlement.name: Not Eligible Balance Related Entitlement
NotEligibleBalanceRelatedEntitlement.definition: Corporate action entitlement for which a non eligible balance is specified.

RelatedIntraPositionTransfer.name: Related Intra Position Transfer
RelatedIntraPositionTransfer.definition: Transfer between two balances or sub balances.

Pledgee.name: Pledgee
Pledgee.definition: Pledgee at which the securities are held.
